set.body:
Public, design-only API over a built design (per run): VIF per column that tolerates rank loss (finite for non-aliased columns, infinite for aliased ones); R² of a column on each block of columns (each event term, motion/confounds, drift/intercept); largest joint contributors (standardized coefficients); pairwise correlation (reuse DesignExports.correlationMap).
Acceptance: independent recomputation fixtures (numpy/R) on a full-rank and a rank-deficient design; matches to 1e-10.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: Design diagnostics API: VIF, block R² decomposition and joint contributors
